# ns-frame

> Tiny (9 KB gzip core), dependency-free library for native UI shapes on the web: bevels, notches, scoops, squircles and fillets on any corner of any element via a small shape language in HTML attributes (`data-ns="tl+br bevel 18; radius 3"`), with borders that follow the cut (`--ns-border`), geometry morphing, shape-preserving apertures, shaped components (toasts, carousel, skeletons, popovers, View Transitions, draggable sheet, navigation island), free-form mosaics, concentric corners, text that fills a shape, multi-line highlights, liquid (gooey) groups and build-time compilation to CSS `shape()`. Strict-CSP safe, accessible, MIT. Docs are in Spanish.

Install: not on npm yet (any npm package named ns-frame is not ours). Load `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/kodecagency/ns-frame@v0.10.0/packages/ns-frame/dist/ns-frame.js`; modules come from the same `dist/` folder and version (`dist/ns-toast.js`…).

Key rules: import the core once (`import 'ns-frame'`); never use CSS `border` on shaped elements (use `--ns-border`); use `data-ns-pad` for text containers; optional modules are imported by path (`ns-frame/toast`, `ns-frame/vt`…); verify with `audit({ clearance: 5 })` from `ns-frame/audit`.

## Docs (Spanish)

- [Introducción](https://github.com/kodecagency/ns-frame/blob/main/docs/introduccion.md)
- [Instalación](https://github.com/kodecagency/ns-frame/blob/main/docs/instalacion.md): CDN (jsDelivr), import maps, bundlers, Astro, React, Vue, Svelte
- [Sintaxis de formas](https://github.com/kodecagency/ns-frame/blob/main/docs/sintaxis.md)
- [Estilo y bordes](https://github.com/kodecagency/ns-frame/blob/main/docs/estilo.md)
- [Movimiento](https://github.com/kodecagency/ns-frame/blob/main/docs/movimiento.md)
- [Layout](https://github.com/kodecagency/ns-frame/blob/main/docs/layout.md)
- [Mosaico](https://github.com/kodecagency/ns-frame/blob/main/docs/mosaico.md): `ns-frame/mosaic` — free-form bento (L/T/U pieces with a constant gap), shaped orbs (circle, hex, diamond, triangle) that cut their neighbours and can hold content, connected light effects via `data-ns-mosaic`
- [Componentes](https://github.com/kodecagency/ns-frame/blob/main/docs/componentes.md): popovers, toasts, carousel, skeletons, View Transitions, `ns-frame/sheet`, `ns-frame/isle`, callouts, and what CSS can't do yet: `ns-frame/concentric` (`data-ns-concentric`), `ns-frame/flow` (`data-ns-flow`), `ns-frame/mark` (`data-ns-mark`), `ns-frame/liquid` (`data-ns-liquid`; `="glass"` for liquid glass with a lens in every engine), `ns-frame/glass` (`data-ns-glass`: liquid glass on any element with its exact ns-frame shape or border-radius; `facet` = cut glass lit per facet, `prism` = chromatic dispersion), `ns-frame/relief` (`data-ns-relief`: opaque materials with real volume computed from the shape, lit per pixel; controls sink when pressed / aria-pressed / aria-checked), `ns-frame/tabs` (`data-ns-tabs`, liquid-glass tabs whose indicator can be dragged)
- [Efectos](https://github.com/kodecagency/ns-frame/blob/main/docs/efectos.md)
- [Formas sin JS](https://github.com/kodecagency/ns-frame/blob/main/docs/sin-js.md)
- [API de JavaScript](https://github.com/kodecagency/ns-frame/blob/main/docs/api.md)
